assignments.description: Sets Accelerated_Lockout_Period_End_Date__c to 90 days after Pro_Account_Cancelled_Date__c.
assignments.name: Set_Lockout_End_Date_from_Pro_Cancelled_Date
assignments.label: Set Lockout End Date from Pro Cancelled Date

assignments.description: Sets Accelerated_Lockout_Period_End_Date__c to 90 days after Today.
assignments.name: Set_Lockout_End_Date_from_Today
assignments.label: Set Lockout End Date from Today

decisions.description: Determines whether to calculate the lockout end date from the Pro Account Cancelled Date or from today's date.
decisions.name: Is_Pro_Account_Cancelled_Date_populated
decisions.label: Is Pro Account Cancelled Date populated?

Flow.description: When Account_Status__c changes to "closed" and the prior Type is "Accelerated-AGP" or "Accelerated-AGP Premier", then Accelerated_Lockout_Period_End_Date__c is set to Pro_Account_Cancelled_Date__c + 90 days (if populated), otherwise sets it to today + 90 days. This drives In_Accelerated_Lockout_Period__c, preventing the Account from rejoining an Accelerated tier during the lockout period. S3P-1491 - Created
Flow.label: Account_StatusClosed_Accelerated_UpdateLockoutEndDate

start.filterFormula:
/* Account Status changes to closed; normalize capitalization because Account_Status__c is a text field. Using PRIOR Type so the flow also catches transactions where Status and Type change in the same update. */
LOWER ({!$Record__Prior.Account_Status__c} ) != "closed" && LOWER ({!$Record.Account_Status__c} ) = "closed" && ( TEXT ({!$Record__Prior.Type})= "Accelerated-AGP" || TEXT ({!$Record__Prior.Type}) = "Accelerated-AGP Premier" )
